boxes.title: Count parcels by outcome
boxes.plain: Counts done, failed and held jobs under their Outcome names: delivered, dead_letter, held. Jobs still pending or leased are not outcomes yet.
outputs: counts plus held, failed and delivered lists

boxes.title: Write the report text
boxes.plain: Lays the counts out as text: one row per outcome name, then lists of held parcels with their reason, dead letters with their last error, and delivered labels.

boxes.title: Save the report file
boxes.plain: Writes a temp file and swaps it into place. If that fails with an OS error it waits and tries again, with no cap on the number of tries.
boxes.failure: OSError sends it to the wait box

boxes.title: Wait and try again
boxes.plain: Sleeps min(2 to the attempt, 30) seconds, then loops back to the write. No attempt limit is written in the code.

boxes.title: Report saved
boxes.plain: The report path is returned to the caller.

boxes.title: Returned to sender
boxes.plain: An outcome name the report prints as a row, always 0. It is declared in Outcome, but no code sets a parcel to it.

routes.why: publish passes the summary straight to render.
publish passes the text straight to write_report.
The temp file replaced the report path, so the path is returned.
Any OSError while writing or swapping the file is caught and counted as an attempt.
The while True loop starts the write again; nothing in the code ends it except a success.
